profile.headline: Building @ Belisar
profile.summary:
Full stack engineer focused on building real products end-to-end across distributed systems, data, and AI.
Recently co-founded Celna, where I worked on AI-driven systems and product experiences. Now at Pryzm, working on product and data systems in an early-stage environment.
Interested in data pipelines, retrieval, and building systems that turn data into useful products.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Built an AI agent platform with a custom protocol, SDK, and CLI for tool building to inject interactive micro-frontends directly inside the chat interface via WebView messaging.

Engineered the backend runtime, tool permission and execution system, and a zero-trust security model with end-to-end encrypted token/data storage, per-user encryption keys, and server-opaque cross-device data sync.

Evolved the product into an MCP multiplexing layer with dynamic OAuth, credential management, and permissioning across connectors
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · qdrant · React Native · Next.js · FastAPI · Kubernetes · MCP · OAuth

positions.description: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Hardware acceleration · Data Compression · Cryptography · Performance Tuning · Docker Products · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS)
